# Ticket Templates

Use these templates to create consistent work items. Copy the appropriate template into `docs/tickets/` or a project-selected tracker, then adapt the fields to the chosen workflow.

Use the lifecycle guidance to keep ticket status, transitions, and completion criteria consistent across creation, execution, and closeout.

| Type | Use for | Template |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Feature | User-visible capability | [feature](feature.md) |
| Task | Implementation or documentation work | [task](task.md) |
| Bug | Defect correction | [bug](bug.md) |
| Chore | Maintenance | [chore](chore.md) |
| Spike | Time-boxed learning | [spike](spike.md) |

See [lifecycle/statuses](lifecycle/statuses.md), [lifecycle/transitions](lifecycle/transitions.md), and [definition of done](lifecycle/definition-of-done.md).
